description: We’re Sarawak Orbiters, three Sarawakian engineers with backgrounds in aerospace, mechanical engineering, and cybersecurity. We came together with a shared goal of building something that could benefit our communities. When fires and haze blanketed Borneo for months in 2026, robbing over 3,500 lives in September alone, the crisis hit close to home. It inspired us to build IGNIS to aid local responders and authorities monitor, prepare and respond better for the coming fire seasons in the region.
